# awscc_codeconnections_host (Resource)

A resource that represents the infrastructure where a third-party provider is installed. You create one host for all connections to that provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the host.
- `provider_endpoint` (String) The endpoint of the infrastructure where your provider type is installed.
- `provider_type` (String) The name of the installed provider to be associated with your connection.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to apply to the host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `vpc_configuration` (Attributes) The VPC configuration provisioned for the host. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_configuration))

### Read-Only

- `host_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the host.
- `host_id` (String) The server-generated unique identifier for the host.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the host.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The tag's key.
- `value` (String) The tag's value.


<a id="nestedatt--vpc_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc_configuration`

Optional:

- `security_group_ids` (List of String) The ID of the security group or security groups associated with the Amazon VPC.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) The ID of the subnet or subnets associated with the Amazon VPC.
- `tls_certificate` (String) The value of the Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate associated with the infrastructure where your provider type is installed.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the Amazon VPC connected to the infrastructure where your provider type is installed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_codeconnections_host.example
  identity = {
    host_arn = "host_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `host_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the host

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_codeconnections_host.example
  id = "host_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_codeconnections_host.example "host_arn"
```
